messages.text: GPT-SaaS should retain original AI conversations, because I need to check where each project decision came from.
Store the source conversation and link every extracted statement to its original message and sentence.
For the database, keep source versions so that reimporting an export does not erase old evidence.
Use source fingerprints and retain prior versions while marking superseded conversations inactive.
The interface should show a topic tree beside the selected topic and its evidence.
A three-panel workspace can show the tree, topic details, and original evidence together.
Conversation Manager needs to turn several chats about the same project into one editable knowledge structure.
Extract fragments by subject and attach related fragments from different conversations to shared topics.
If the model is unsure whether two topics match, what should happen?
Queue the topic match for human review instead of making a duplicate topic automatically.
Project Memory Engine should let me paste three real conversations and compile a topic tree with evidence.
The first release can combine semantic segmentation, topic extraction, cross-conversation matching, and evidence links.
After I correct a fragment's topic, the correction must survive another compile.
Persist the human assignment separately and apply it after each compilation.
The database also needs evidence links for manually moved fragments.
Transfer the fragment's sentence evidence to the corrected topic and keep the original source text.
